item_name: Minimum Training Standards Not Met for the Home Health Aide
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol's Area 17 entry states only that the Home Health Aide must have met minimum training requirements "when services were rendered"; no observation/look-back window in days is stated on p. 13 or elsewhere for this area.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the Home Health Aide did not meet minimum training requirements when services were rendered, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If the Home Health Aide did not meet minimum training requirements when services were rendered, the claim will be disallowed.

federal_coding_rules.rule: This document is guidance only; in the event of a conflict between statements in the protocols and statutory or regulatory requirements, the requirements of the statutes and regulations govern.

source.quote: In the event of a conflict between statements in the protocols and either statutory or regulatory requirements, the requirements of the statutes and regulations govern.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Services provided and billed in accordance with COVID-19 PHE guidance issued by NYS DOH pertaining to ALP services (including DAL: DHCBS 20-10, 21-02 and 21-09 on in-service/orientation/supervision requirements for Home Health Aides) will not be subject to disallowance, provided all other programmatic and billing requirements not altered or waived by the PHE guidance were met.

source.quote: Services provided and billed in accordance with COVID-19 PHE guidance issued by the NYS Department of Health (DOH) pertaining to ALP services will not be subject to disallowance, provided all other programmatic and billing requirements not altered or waived by the PHE guidance were met.

federal.criterion: Documentation that the Home Health Aide met minimum training requirements at the time the services on the sampled claim were rendered (absence results in disallowance).

source.quote: If the Home Health Aide did not meet minimum training requirements when services were rendered, the claim will be disallowed.

federal.notes: The protocol does not enumerate which specific documents (e.g., certificate, Home Care Registry verification) must be present; it cites regulatory references and DOH guidance on verification of training and certificate validity.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The Area 17 entry does not tie Home Health Aide training standards to any payment or case-mix classification. (Rate/RUG-related issues appear in separate protocol areas.)
